cases.long_description: 3 orange bright light orbs moved as a group slowly from the southeast, to almost overhead, moving towards southwest. The sky was clear, no aircraft were nearby, no planets nor the moon nor any satellites were visible at the time of the sighting. Each orb moved independently from each other in slow zig-zag motions and then one by one each flickered then disappeared. The next day we called the local air force bases and asked if they had sent anything up that night but they said no. There was nothing on the news about it.

There was a cloud cover but this light was so bright that it peered through the clouds. After the incident. I was able to view both commercial and private aircraft flying in the general direction of the sighting area. No aircrafts lights were as bright as the object. The object faded away.

cases.location: Met a strange being while in Mexico

cases.long_description: In November 2024 I was on the outskirts of Monterrey Nuevo León Mexico . I was staying in a Airbnb in Los Nogales, Nuevo Leon, Mexico. Had many friends over having a small get together. Late at night when everyone was gathering together inside I went back outside to sit at the fire and just get away from the noise . As I was sitting by the fire I seen someone walking at the edge of the property they were coming my direction so I just thought it was one of my friends walking back to the house. As they got closer I realized they were not one of my friends so I asked them what they wanted . They said nothing to me at first when they looked at me I noticed their eyes were a little bigger than normal I thought maybe they were on drugs that made their pupils huge . When they talked it was like I heard them but didn’t see their lips move at all . They asked for water to drink . As they got closer I noticed they did not have ears well they had ear canals but no ears like it looked as if they would have be cut off . I didn’t want to leave the person so I called my friend Luis and asked him to bring a water outside and to hurry . He came outside and noticed the person that was standing about 10 yards from me. .The second Luis seen the person he said shit because he was surprised by the appearance of the person. The being wouldn’t come any closer to us and maybe it was because of the fire . I grave the water and walked out to it . When I got closer I realized its eyes were not just big from drugs and I actually got scared . Instantly as I got scared the sound of its voice in my head said do not worry it is ok . When it reached out for the water I noticed its fingers were rather long . It grabbed the water turned around and walked off . To this day it is the strangest experience I have ever had in my life . I have no clue what I encountered. To me it seem like a person but slightly different skin texture and color and then the eyes and ears. Luis said it was a devil from the mountains . I have no explanation on what it could have been . I have never thought about reporting it because I just figured maybe it was just a deformed person . But then I could not explain to myself how I heard it talk but like it was in my head . Then I have doubt myself that maybe it’s lips really moved and it was just my eyes playing tricks on me . But then that still doesn’t explain the eyes and ears .
cases.location: Three disk shaped UFOs flew into a Gigantic UFO

cases.long_description: As reported to Regional Director by phone: This sighting occurred sometime between 1969 and 1972. I am 81 years old and I wanted to tell someone about some of the strange things I've witnessed. I was headed to Newtonia, MO with my wife, sister and friend. It was dusk with some sunlight. We saw a gigantic ship measuring at least 100' across hovering 200' or less above the ground, and three small disk shaped objects flew into the larger craft, then it instantly took off at an amazing rate of speed to the NE. I have had UFO and entity sightings since that time. Currently, there is an area on my property where a light appears on a regular basis and this is right over an area where we found a depressed circle in our field.

cases.location: Looked like a satellite, until it turned around.

cases.long_description: 7pm Friday night January 31st my wife and I were sitting in our hot tub on our deck outside faces the lake. I was looking in the sky it was a beautiful clear night no wind. I was watching satellites heading in different directions. I was telling my wife there goes another satellite, this one was directly overhead heading south. I kept watching it and just before it made it across the lake , about 1/4 mile. It turned and started heading towards us same altitude same path but as it got closer it had flashing red, green and white lights. It was completely silent. As it approached it was directly overhead and I could make out the shape. It just had wings but they were glowing underneath and all the edges of the wings were brighter white. I just wish I had my phone on me to video this. I've been living on this lake all my life and never have I seen anything like this.

At first, it appeared to be reflecting the sunlight. But as I watched it, it slowly faded away. It literally disappeared. Or at least seem to. As it faded it completely seem to turn off or hide like something that could cloak. It was a brief sighting for me. About 10 seconds. The thing that surprised me was how it seemed to fade right away. Curious if anyone else noticed this. Somewhere between 230 and 3 PM. On Sunday, February 2, 2025.
